description: YHColorWall-5100 is a single-component, ready to use water resistant white cement based finishing / smoothening mastic for indoor and outdoor concrete structures. This product features excellent anti-seepage, anti-mold, leveling, and decorative properties.
whereToUse: repair and waterproofing of damaged concrete or masonry structures
new construction and maintenance of exterior walls, interior walls, elevator pits, pools, culverts, and underground garage side walls
restoring the aesthetic and functional performance of buildings
advantages: Excellent white look and smooth finish.
Excellent anti-seepage performance, with a coating anti-seepage pressure greater than 1.0MPa.
Cured surface shows distinct anti-efflorescence effect.
Superb bonding: white cement base provides great adhesion to walls.
Can be applied on moist surface.
Anti-sagging: The material does not slip or sag during vertical construction.
notFor: This product contains alkaline substances such as cement, which may cause skin allergies. Protective measures should be taken during use.
The construction temperature should be between 5 °C and 35 °C. Do not construct in rainy, snowy, or windy conditions above level 5. Avoid rain flush and construction on frozen substrates.
The mortar has a workable time of about 1 hour. Variations in construction temperature and humidity may affect the workable time.
Do not add water to the mortar after initial setting and reuse it.
There should not be any mildew or algae on the surface.

technicalData.label: Pull bond to concrete, MPa (ASTM D7234)
Substrate temperature
technicalData.value: ≥ 3 °C above dew point, beware of condensation

technicalData.label: Shelf life
technicalData.value: the shelf life is 12 months from the date of production

consumption.quote: Material consumption is dependent on the porosity and texture of the substrate. Normally, it is about 1.50 to 1.80 kg/m² for a 1 mm dry film thickness.
The thickness of each application should not be less than 1.0mm, and the final thickness of the plaster layer should not be less than 3mm.

mixing: First mix the supplied YHColorWall-5100 with a water-to-powder ratio of (0.18-0.20) : 1 & continue mixing until a homogeneous lump free paste of desired consistency is obtained.
packaging: 20 kg per pail or 20kg per bag
storage: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Protect from sunlight, rain, frost and humidity.
